note: Part of report-40 (ai-make-room, scripts/stage-d/make-room-split.ts): 'state' is the state after the original file's moves[177], computed by the engine of record (src at 0dd09303bdf734f13dabd447692a8b1d6aa4a06c, before c6c6de4), and 'moves' are the original moves[178..344]. moves[176] used Madani and moves[177] answered it with Chromatophores over a full memory and no program trashed first; that engine spent Madani and installed nothing. Rules 8.5.6c ("They must do so if installing the new program would exceed their memory limit") makes that answer illegal, so the file is split instead of picking a trash set for the human. Replay 'moves' from 'state' (startsAt), not from 'config'; firstMove is the original index of moves[0].
